title: Field Shift: choose the visual world
question: Three worlds inside your pinned look (white, celeste, sunrise, NASA mood, Lemo-Opuscar type). Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Agroclimatic Bulletin
options.lineage: daylight synoptic weather charts and agroclimatic bulletins
options.thesis: Your field drawn as a weather station on a morning chart: one compound glyph carries heat, rain, water and pests.
materials: hairline isobars on white chart paper
Source Serif 4 and tracked Source Sans 3
options.viewport: The valley as a pale chart with celeste isobars; your field is the station glyph at center, one reading set large beside it, the source line underneath.
options.risk: Farmers do not read synoptic charts; the glyph must teach itself or it becomes decoration.

raised.raise: Anomaly is a strict nine-step celeste-to-sunrise ramp, the only tonal tokens: every warm step is a measured departure from the 40-year normal.
A ruling engine draws every isobar, bracket and reticle at one device pixel from the live layout.
Nothing disappears: each rotation option is stamped considered, set aside or chosen, and the export tears off as a stub for the engineer.
Panels persist over the chart; navigation changes their contents, never the map beneath.

options.label: Daylight Mission Briefing
options.lineage: Lemo-Opuscar Satellite Briefing, regraded from analyst grey to sunrise
options.thesis: Real satellite imagery of your field at dawn, a thin reticle around it, and one sourced reading at a time.
materials: true-color Sentinel-2 imagery graded to morning light
Source Serif 4 and tracked Source Sans 3
options.viewport: Full-bleed image of the valley warming at sunrise, the field outlined with corner brackets, a single large reading and its source in the white sky above.
options.risk: It is the literal reading of the reference you showed, so it is also the most expected answer.

options.label: One Reading per Screen
options.lineage: full-screen vertical feeds farmers already scroll every day
options.thesis: The report becomes a vertical feed: each finding owns the whole phone screen over your field, one flick to the next.
materials: full-bleed field imagery with a white sky scrim
Source Serif 4 and tracked Source Sans 3
options.viewport: Your field fills the screen; the reading and verdict sit low-left, a right rail offers source, ask the consultant, add to sheet, share.
options.case: Beats the bulletin on both axes: farmers already read their phone this way, and one reading per screen is the briefing's own discipline.
options.risk: Can feel like social media; the three-rotation comparison needs a calm non-feed view.

options.label: Field Course Map
options.lineage: orienteering maps: fixed terrain language, the course riding on top
options.thesis: NASA data is the terrain in a fixed color language; the rotation plan rides above it as a numbered course, season to season.
materials: sunrise-amber course line reserved for the plan
options.viewport: Your field as terrain (celeste moisture, green vigor, white bare soil) with the rotation course drawn over it, controls numbered by season.
options.case: Clearest split between data and plan; loses on audience, since few farmers know orienteering maps.
options.risk: The legend has to be learned before the map pays off.

options.label: Exposure Record Sheets
options.thesis: Overlapping translucent sheets over a backlit zone ramp.
options.viewport: Stacked sheets with hatch densities over a field.
options.risk: Farmers have no darkroom to identify with.
options.kept: A strict tonal ramp as the only tonal tokens, now the anomaly scale.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Page
options.thesis: Two text columns twinned around a rail of keys.
options.viewport: Two narrow columns with a keyed centre rail.
options.risk: Two columns collapse on a phone; bookish for a field tool.
options.kept: The ruling engine: every hairline drawn at one device pixel from live layout.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels divided by hairline seams.
options.risk: Dark contradicts the pinned daylight look and fails in bright sun.
options.kept: Persistent panels: navigation changes contents, not the layout.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each season as a coupon torn off in sequence.
options.viewport: A wallet of season coupons with stamped states.
options.risk: Travel ephemera is far from the farmer's world.
options.kept: Stamped states where nothing disappears, and the export as a tear-off stub.

canonCard.label: The agritech dashboard standard
canonCard.thesis: What farm-data apps ship: a map, metric cards and charts, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Map on top, metric cards below, a chart and a list of recommendations.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any farm dashboard by design.
